title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
B2 B Sales Executive Health and Wellness DTC Retailer SW London

Location: SW London / regular client meetings and pitches

Salary: Up to 35,000 base + UNCAPPED COMMISSION

Zachary Daniels are again delighted to be supporting one of the fastest growing wellness brands in the UK who are on a mission to help people move better, recover faster and feel stronger in their bodies.

A Sunday Times Top 10 fastest growing business, they are changing the way people recover, bringing world-class recovery technology out of elite sport and into everyday life. From F1, Olympic Athletes and Wimbledon Tennis to people simply wanting to feel and perform at their best, they are building products, experiences and spaces that make physical and mental recovery more accessible.

The Opportunity:

As the business continues to grow at a rapid rate they are now receiving a significant volume of inbound enquiries from gyms, hotels, sports clubs, wellness spaces and other businesses wanting to create dedicated branded recovery rooms and our client is looking for someone exceptionally hungry to take ownership of this opportunity.

This will not be a traditional sales role where you inherit a process and simply work through a pipeline. You will need to build it. This is a brand new role with infinite opportunity that for the right person will be a rocket ship!

As B2 B Sales Executive you will take ownership of their growing B2 B recovery-space channel: converting inbound opportunities, developing relationships, pitching the brand, closing deals and ultimately building a repeatable sales engine that can become a significant part of the business.

There are already leads coming in. Your job will be to turn them into revenue and then find more.

You will need to be commercially hungry, brilliant with people and relentless about getting things over the line.

This role will require someone to own their own sales pipeline, forecasting and reporting, whilst working closely with the wider team to ensure a brilliant experience from initial enquiry through to installation and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.

This role is about building the playbook for this entire area of the business.

Who We're Looking For:
- You'll have a minimum of two years' experience in a B2 B sales role where you have delivered growth across a partnerships model - fitness, health and wellness, sports, property, recruitment industries would all be good fits.
- As a minimum you will have a passion and thirst for the Health and Wellness industry, ideally you will have worked within it in some capacity but more than anything you will bring the right personality, 'can-do' attitude and hunger to the role.
- You are naturally commercial and love closing.
- You get energy from speaking to people and building relationships.
- You are highly proactive and don't wait to be given a to-do list.
- Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where not everything has been figured out yet.
- You want your earning potential to be linked directly to the value they create.
- Is ambitious and wants the chance to build something, not simply step into something already built.

Intretech is an international consumer electronics manufacturer with 15 factories and more than 40 subsidiaries worldwide. While we're a smaller player relative to the industry's biggest names, that's part of what makes us distinctive: candidates get to make a visible impact rather than being one of thousands in a large corporate structure.

Our multicultural and dynamic team is expanding, and we are seeking a driven Business Development Executive to lead account development and growth initiatives across European markets, supporting our European factory operations.

- Demonstrated ability to generate new business and meet or exceed sales targets.
- Strong understanding of CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce) and their application in sales strategy.
- Knowledge of manufacturing processes, supply chains, and product development.
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and persuade at all levels of an organisation.
- Fluency in a European language is a strong advantage, particularly German or French.
- Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural team environment.
- Valid passport, with willingness to travel across Europe as required.
- Right to work in the UK.

Our Culture

At Intretech, you'll be part of a global sales team that values diversity, creativity, and a hands-on, get-things-done attitude. We are troubleshooters and doers, united in our mission to lead the market through innovation and service excellence.

Compensation and Benefits
- A key role in our continued growth, working with great people in a supportive and flexible environment.
- Private medical insurance.
- Workplace pension scheme with employer contributions.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Professional development and career growth opportunities.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.

How to Apply:

If you have the skills and experience required for this position, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

You must be eligible to work in the UK.

Other suitable skills and experience includes Business Development Manager, Business Development Executive, Sales Manager, International Sales Manager, European Sales Manager, Regional Sales Manager, Key Account Manager, Strategic Account Manager, Account Development Manager, Commercial Manager, Sales Executive, Technical Sales Manager, Manufacturing Sales Manager, Electronics Sales Manager, OEM Sales Manager, B2 B Sales Manager, New Business Development Manager, Business Development Specialist.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Where: EE Tyneisde (Silver Fox Way, Newcastle upon Tyne NE27 0 QJ)

Full time: Permanent

Salary: £26,116 rising to £26.738 after 8 months of being here, plus incentives and bonuses

Start date: October 2026 onwards

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.
